title: Special Executive Programme In Human Resource Management
description: Master the core principles and strategic role of Human Resource Management to enhance organizational productivity and performance.
longDescription: This Special Executive Programme delves into the dynamics of Human Resource Management, emphasizing its role as a strategic partner in driving organizational success. Participants will gain insights into modern HR practices, performance management, and the latest HR trends and innovations.
courseDetails: Critically analyse the concepts and importance of Human Resource Management principles. Explain the issues and challenges of HR managers. Understand strategic HRM and its importance. Analyse theories of motivation and models of Human Resources. Understand the role and importance of Human Resource Management as a Strategic Partner. Explain the difference between an HR manager and an HR strategic partner. Understand the core task of HR as a strategic partner. Understand negotiation and employee engagement. Explore factors that affect employees’ productivity. Understand the dynamics of managing a multi-generational workforce. Explain the difference between different generations of the workforce at the workplace. To explain trends and innovation in HR policies. To understand retention strategy and organisational change process. To explore team synergies and their role. Understand the dynamics of rightsizing the organisation. Explain the difference between rightsizing and downsizing. Explain methods and process of rightsizing. Understand the dynamics of employees’ productivity and emerging challenges to productivity. Explore performance management and Emerging Approaches to the Performance Management System. Understand employee motivation and its different aspects. The programme explores the principles and practices of HRM, highlighting its long-term impact on organizational environments. Participants will critically analyze HR competencies, including strategic HRM, employee motivation, and engagement. The course also covers managing multi-generational workforces, innovative HR policies, and the differences between rightsizing and downsizing. Emerging challenges in productivity, performance management, and employee retention strategies are discussed to optimize organizational efficiency. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; The Dynamics of Human Resource Management: Enhancing Human Resource Competencies: Human Resource Management as a Strategic Partner: Concepts in Managing and Utilizing Human Resources: Optimizing Organizational Productivity and Performance Management:
